You can: pick up a free map or nature sheet find out about upcoming events and activities ask questions of our friendly team buy Hampstead Heath-related goodies (e.g. books, cards, bags)

Near Home.title: Litter pick
Near Home.summary: Join us for a Saturday afternoon litter pick. All welcome and all equipment provided. Meet at 12pm at the Heath Info Hut (the former Tennis Bookings Hut), Hampstead Heath, near the Parliament Hill tennis courts - no need to book, although you can let us know that you’re planning to come along so that we know roughly how many to expect.

Near Home.title: Kenwood Tree Walk
Near Home.summary: Join us for a guided walk to discover more about the trees of the Kenwood Estate and learn how to identify them in Autumn. The walk will start in the Kenwood area area (book on for the exact meeting point) and will last for about an hour and a half. Near Home.title: Family creative walk
Near Home.summary: Join us for a family-friendly guided creative walk.
